/school-cleaning.title: School Cleaning London, Term Time & Holidays | Fresh Finish
/school-cleaning.description: School cleaning in London for primary and secondary schools, academies and nurseries. DBS-checked staff, cleaning around the school day and photo proof.

sections.heading: How a school cleaning contract with us is set up
paragraphs: We start with a free site survey so we can walk the building with you, look at access, timetable and the areas that matter most, then agree the full specification and schedule before anything is signed. Nothing is assumed, so you know exactly which rooms are cleaned, how often, and when the team will be on site.

Once the contract starts, daily cleaning runs around the school day and larger deep cleans are booked into half-terms and holidays. Every visit is checked in and out on site, and before-and-after photos go into your own portal, so you can see the standard without walking the building yourself.

If something is not right, flag it and it is put right on the very next clean. Insurance certificates and vetting details are shared on request, which keeps things simple when governors or auditors ask who is on site and how the work is evidenced.

sections.heading: What to check when comparing school cleaning contractors
paragraphs: Ask who will actually be on site and how they are vetted. Our staff on school sites are DBS-checked and we are fully insured, and we work to the safeguarding expectations schools have for any contractor coming through the gate.

Ask how the standard is recorded. A contractor that photographs and logs every clean saves you chasing and gives business managers, bursars and trusts something concrete to show when the contract is reviewed.

Ask whether the specification is built around your site rather than a standard list. Primary classrooms, secondary labs and changing rooms, dining halls and nursery play areas all need different attention, and we size the team and the schedule to match how your site runs.

faqs.question: Which parts of London do you cover for school cleaning?
faqs.answer: North London, North West London, Central London, East London, North East London and West London, including Enfield and the surrounding boroughs, plus selected parts of Hertfordshire and Essex such as Borehamwood, Watford, St Albans, Loughton, Chigwell and Romford. Send us your postcode and we will confirm.

faqs.question: What is included in your school cleaning service?
faqs.answer: Classrooms and learning spaces, washrooms and toilets, halls, dining areas and corridors, offices, reception and staff rooms, plus holiday and half-term deep cleans and one-off cleans for events and open days. Tell us anything else your site needs and we will confirm what we can include in the quote.

faqs.question: How do we get a quote for school cleaning?
faqs.answer: Call 020 3927 4499, message us on WhatsApp or request a quote online with details of your site, timetable and the areas you need covered. We can book a free site survey and come back with a clear proposal.

/office-cleaning/essex.title: Office Cleaning Essex | Contract Cleaners | Fresh Finish
/office-cleaning/essex.description: Office cleaning in Essex for businesses, managing agents and serviced offices in Loughton, Chigwell, Romford and Epping. Free site survey and fixed price.

sections.heading: Which parts of Essex we cover for office cleaning
paragraphs: Our Essex office cleaning covers selected areas close to the London border: Loughton, Chigwell, Romford, Ilford and Epping, along with the IG1, IG7, IG10, RM1 and CM16 postcodes. That includes town centre offices, business units and shared workspaces.

If your office is further out in Essex, for example Chelmsford, Brentwood or Saffron Walden, those towns are not on our covered list. Call 020 3927 4499 and we will tell you straight away whether we can help, rather than leaving you waiting.
If you sit just outside the postcodes above but near one of the towns we clean, it is still worth asking. We will be clear about what we can and cannot take on.

sections.heading: Contract cleaning in Essex for offices, serviced sites and managing agents
paragraphs: Contract cleaning means a written specification rather than an open-ended hourly arrangement. We agree every area, task and frequency with you, covering desks and touch points, kitchens and tea points, washrooms, meeting rooms, floors and bins, then hold a fixed price after the free site survey.

We work with businesses, managing agents and serviced offices, so one point of contact matters. Your contract is run by one named account manager who knows the building and answers the phone, and reviews happen regularly rather than only when something goes wrong.

For landlords and agents reporting to tenants, every visit is time-stamped as cleaners check in and out on site, and before and after photos land in your client portal next to the invoice. Teams are DBS-checked and fully insured, with teams available for sensitive sites.

faqs.question: Do you cover Chelmsford, Brentwood or Saffron Walden?
faqs.answer: Those towns are not among the Essex areas we list. We clean offices in and around Loughton, Chigwell, Romford, Ilford and Epping, and the IG1, IG7, IG10, RM1 and CM16 postcodes. Call 020 3927 4499 and we will confirm either way.

faqs.question: What is the difference between office cleaning and contract cleaning?
faqs.answer: Contract cleaning is a regular schedule set out in a written specification, with every area, task and frequency agreed up front and a fixed price after a free site survey.

faqs.question: Do you clean serviced offices and shared workspaces in Essex?
faqs.answer: Yes. We clean offices for businesses, managing agents and serviced offices, including town centre offices, business units and shared workspaces in the Essex areas we cover.

/office-cleaning/north-west-london.title: Office Cleaning Hampstead & North West London | Fresh Finish
/office-cleaning/north-west-london.description: Contract office cleaning in Hampstead and across North West London, with one named account manager, photo reports every visit and a fixed price.

sections.heading: Office cleaning across NW2, NW3 and the surrounding postcodes
paragraphs: Our North West London cleaning covers NW2, NW3, NW6, NW8 and NW10, so offices in Hampstead, St John's Wood, Kilburn and Willesden are all on the same routes. Professional practices in Hampstead and St John's Wood often need quieter, out of hours visits, and that is how we usually work.

The HA0, HA1 and HA9 postcodes take in Wembley and Harrow, where a lot of the space is serviced or shared workspace. We write the specification around how the building is actually used, including the open plan areas and the smaller private rooms.
If your office is near these postcodes but not named here, call 020 3927 4499 and we will tell you straight away whether we cover it.

sections.heading: Offices outside North West London
paragraphs: Plenty of businesses looking for office cleaning in this part of London have a second site elsewhere. We also clean offices in North London, including Islington, Camden and Highgate, and in Central London, including Marylebone, Fitzrovia and Soho.

Further out, we cover West London around Notting Hill, Kensington and Chiswick, East London around Shoreditch, Hackney and Bethnal Green, and North East London around Stoke Newington, Dalston and Walthamstow. Hertfordshire sites in Borehamwood, Watford and St Albans are covered too, along with Essex locations such as Loughton, Chigwell and Romford.
Multiple sites can run on the same written specification and the same reporting, so you see every visit logged and photographed in one client portal.

faqs.question: Do you clean serviced offices and shared workspaces?
faqs.answer: Yes. We clean serviced and shared workspaces, including sites around Wembley and Harrow, as well as professional practices and business units along the North Circular.

faqs.question: What is included in an office cleaning contract?
faqs.answer: We agree a written specification covering desks and touch points, kitchens and tea points, washrooms, meeting rooms, floors and bins, and how often each area is cleaned.

faqs.question: How do we get a price for our office?
faqs.answer: Book a free site survey. We walk the building with you, write down every area, task and frequency, then send a fixed price with no hourly surprises. Call 020 3927 4499 to arrange it.
